# llm/browser-key

LLM API key in browser code.

An LLM SDK or a direct request to an LLM API in code that runs in the browser, with a key from a public env var (VITE_, NEXT_PUBLIC_, ...) or a literal, including SDKs created with dangerouslyAllowBrowser: true.

- Default level: `block`.
- Levels: block for a key from a public env var or a literal in browser code; warn for dangerouslyAllowBrowser: true in server code (it has no effect there) and in browser code whose key is missing or undefined in the browser; warn in example, sample, and demo folders.
- Looks at: the project as a whole, across files.
- References: [CWE-200](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/200.html), [CWE-522](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/522.html), [CWE-798](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/798.html), OWASP LLM02:2025, OWASP LLM10:2025, OWASP A04:2025.

## Why it matters

Everything in the browser bundle is public: anyone who opens the site can copy the key from the JavaScript and run up usage on your account. This is the most common leak in AI-built apps that call OpenAI or Gemini straight from the browser.

## Flagged

`src/api.js` (block):

```js
apiKey: process.env.REACT_APP_OPENAI_API_KEY,
```

`app/components/Assistant.tsx` (warn):

```tsx
const anthropic = new Anthropic({ apiKey: process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, dangerouslyAllowBrowser: true });
```

`app/components/Chat.tsx` (block):

```tsx
const openai = new OpenAI({ apiKey: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENAI_API_KEY, dangerouslyAllowBrowser: true });
```

`lib/ai.ts` (block):

```ts
const provider = createOpenAI({ apiKey: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENAI_KEY });
```

`examples/browser-demo/main.ts` (warn):

```ts
const client = new OpenAI({ apiKey: import.meta.env.VITE_OPENAI_API_KEY, dangerouslyAllowBrowser: true });
```

`server/index.ts` (warn):

```ts
const legacy = new OpenAI({ apiKey: process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY, dangerouslyAllowBrowser: true });
```

`src/api/assistant.ts` (block):

```ts
export const client = new OpenAI({ apiKey: OPENAI_API_KEY });
```

`src/api/assistant.ts` (block):

```ts
const ai = new GoogleGenAI({ apiKey: ensureGeminiKey() });
```

## Not flagged

- `const openai = new OpenAI();` in `app/api/chat/route.ts`: route handlers run on the server
- `const provider = createOpenAI({ apiKey: process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY });` in `app/api/chat/route.ts`: server-only key in a route handler
- `headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ${process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY}' },` in `app/api/chat/route.ts`: server code
- `const openai = new OpenAI({ apiKey: process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY });` in `server/index.ts`: server code with a server-only key
- `return new OpenAI({ apiKey: userKey, dangerouslyAllowBrowser: true });` in `src/lib/openai.ts`: the user's own key
- `export const viaProxy = new OpenAI({ baseURL: '/api/openai', apiKey: 'unused', dangerouslyAllowBrowser: true });` in `src/lib/openai.ts`: the app's own proxy holds the key
- `export const local = new OpenAI({ baseURL: 'http://localhost:11434/v1', apiKey: 'ollama', dangerouslyAllowBrowser: true });` in `src/lib/openai.ts`: a local model server
- `const res = await fetch('/api/chat', { method: 'POST', headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ${token}' }, body: JSON.stringify({ prompt }) });` in `src/services/chat.ts`: the app's own API
- `const res = await fetch('https://api.openweathermap.org/data/2.5/weather?q=${city}&appid=${import.meta.env.VITE_WEATHER_KEY}');` in `src/services/chat.ts`: not an LLM API

## How to fix

Move the model call to a server route or Server Action that reads the key from a server-only env var, and have the browser call that route.

## If the finding is wrong

Add a comment on the line above, in the comment syntax of the file, that says who decided and why:

```
ubon-ignore llm/browser-key: <who decided>: <evidence>
```

Or turn the rule off for the project in `ubon.json`: `"rules": { "llm/browser-key": "off" }`. See [configuration](../../config.md).
